source_note: Research against pinned NeoForge 1.21.1 mod roster; some sources describe comparable ATM10/ATM11 or other mod versions; all item IDs/recipes still require live JEI confirmation

definitions.early: Starter materials/initial craft, not necessarily literally in first minutes
definitions.short_chain: Few early mod-specific steps, no known boss gate
definitions.later: Worth cross-referencing but misleading as an immediate tip
definitions.unknown: Not enough version-specific evidence to set early accessibility
definitions.strong: Upstream official book/source or clear 1.21.1 behavior
definitions.tentative: Unverified candidate; do not convert into player-facing instructional claim

records.benefit: Once you have the novice book, the Tier 1 Break glyph can mine ordinary blocks using spell mana.
records.caveat: Requires book and sufficient mana; harvest level/ore drops must be checked in pack.

records.benefit: Tier 1: place persistent magical light on blocks or grant temporary night vision when self-cast.
records.caveat: Avoid falsely claiming it is free or consumes no mana.

records.benefit: Tier 1 aerial hops or forward leaps; earlier than true sustained flight.
records.caveat: Landing hazards remain; no guaranteed safe fall.

records.benefit: Use entry-tier effects for crop harvesting and shearing-style utility.
records.caveat: Check crop and harvest interaction per mod, not universal crop doubling.

records.benefit: Tier 2 field smelting of blocks or dropped items; AOE handles multiple, Dampen selects smoking.
records.caveat: REQUIRES Mage-tier casting and glyph crafting; not the Storage Lectern.

records.benefit: Central access and crafting from linked inventories; protects pack's magical-storage identity.
records.caveat: Enchanting Apparatus, Bookwyrm(s), linked inventories and Dominion Wand; NOT a smelter.

records.benefit: Tier 2 converts stone to gravel, gravel to sand, flowers to dye; JEI determines other recipes.
records.caveat: Do not label generic ore doubling without a recipe for each ore.

records.benefit: One supported ingot/gem to two Mahou catalyst powders; inexpensive entry into useful powder processing.
records.caveat: NOT presently a proven raw-ore doubling-to-ingots route. TMM raw-ore input + smeltable dust is a separate unimplemented compat decision.

records.benefit: Lower-cost alternate to Mortar and Pestle; yields one powder per supported catalyst.
records.caveat: Less efficient than two-powder Mortar; not automatic smelting.

records.benefit: Early hidden-world materials and conversions after collecting seeds from grass.
records.caveat: Not a bulk smelter or automatic 2x ingot processing.

records.benefit: After first ritual/pentacle setup, Foliot processes supported raw ores into two dusts; dust may then be smelted if configured.
records.caveat: Requires Demon's Dream, Dictionary, bound Foliot book, chalk and four ritual material offerings; confirm silver access and dust smelt tags.

records.benefit: Early spirit automation can move or collect dropped items, reducing repetitive pickup.
records.caveat: Requires appropriate separate ritual; avoid describing as free generic pipes.

records.unlock: Demon's Dream Third Eye / Otherworld Goggles
records.benefit: Reveal disguised Otherworld materials without blindly mining them.
records.caveat: Goggles require more ritual progress; the earliest temporary effect may be simpler.

records.benefit: Expandable magical remote storage as an intentional primary storage route.
records.caveat: NOT day-one: ritual and component chain; avoid misleading early-access placement.

records.benefit: Portable 3x3 crafting; wooden variant has 27 slots, standard variant can pair with Ender Chest; keybindable.
records.caveat: Uses Crushed Dark Gems, gold/iron; Ender Chest variant later than wooden variant.

records.benefit: Very high Fortune (typically V) at craft time, with Vengeance curse/spirit-spawning danger.
records.caveat: Needs diamonds, hardened blood shards and undead wood sticks; it is NOT intrinsically a vein miner. Fortune is not traditional 2x raw-ore-to-ingot processing.

records.benefit: Assemble rod, brush and cap; blood-powered flight with custom upgrades.
records.caveat: Requires blood, dark materials and parts; use official Origins of Darkness/JEI for fuel and exact controls. Some secondary pages incorrectly say no fuel.

records.benefit: Pulls item drops and XP; useful for mines, farms and mob areas.
records.caveat: Check blood drain and item range in installed config.

records.benefit: Reusable, blood-fed short-range pearl alternative.
records.caveat: Confirm recipe and usage; not a Waystone or universal dimension teleporter.

records.benefit: Repairs items using Blood rather than repeatedly re-crafting tools.
records.caveat: Needs blood supply and infusion; check repair compatibility.

records.benefit: Distinct broom-flight path involving a broom body/brush and witchcraft materials.
records.caveat: Use correct Hexerei craft sequence, not EvilCraft's blood-powered mechanic.

records.benefit: Retrieve or summon your Hexerei broom after exploring.
records.caveat: Requires a broom first; don't present the whistle as transport on its own.

records.benefit: Physical, thematic delivery mechanism between working areas of a large base.
records.caveat: Could have distance/activation limitations; not equivalent to banned generic item logistics.

records.benefit: Named magical storage option worth comparing against starter Trinkets Pouch.
records.caveat: Check exact recipe/slot count/nesting policy in installed build before advertising.

records.benefit: Store torches and place them remotely, reducing repetitive torch placement.
records.caveat: Requires Molten Core or comparable mob drop; not necessarily day one.

records.benefit: Automatically places light in dark locations using carried torches.
records.caveat: Requires fuel torches and crafting drops; check placement behavior.

records.benefit: Inventory magnet for nearby items/XP; compare against EvilCraft Kineticator and Botania ring.
records.caveat: Documentation conflict with another page calling it a mob-drop booster. Confirm real behavior in pinned 1.21.1 client.

records.benefit: Fuelled aerial mobility / push-pull tool using feathers.
records.caveat: Acquisition more involved; not a reliable first-day craft.

records.benefit: Limited item duplication at charge cost, potentially extremely valuable.
records.caveat: BALANCE BLOCKER: inspect accepted items, costs and interaction with boss/ProjectE gating. Do not feature as an endorsed early shortcut.

records.benefit: Early charcoal/coal-fed mana generation for the first Botania tools and transformations.
records.caveat: Magic mana, not FE. Require actual functional flowers and a mana receiver.

records.benefit: Pulls dropped items toward the wearer after basic Manasteel and lens crafting.
records.caveat: Verify specific port recipe in pack; requires mana setup.

records.benefit: Collects nearby item entities into adjacent inventories.
records.caveat: Requires mana/functional flower setup and nearby storage; avoid blanket AFK item-generation claims.

records.benefit: Stone conversion into ores powered by substantial mana.
records.caveat: NOT beginner access; must not bypass expensive ore progression or locked tech materials.

records.benefit: In pinned 1.21.1 branch, reveals deeply buried Rock Crystal with sparkles; also starts starlight crafting.
records.caveat: Requires focal-point crafting and night sky. This is rock-crystal finding, not a general metal-ore scanner.

records.benefit: Early open-air starlight transformations; book specifically mentions iron ore changing at focal points.
records.caveat: Conversion outcome and ratios must be looked up in the pinned recipe data; do not promise arbitrary ore doubling.

records.benefit: Early mechanical anvil crushing turns gemstone shards into colored powder for Pigment Pedestal work.
records.caveat: Not generic metal-ore 2x; Create crusher integration is irrelevant because Create is excluded.

records.benefit: Processes pure resource clusters into doubled output in a specialized multiblock.
records.caveat: Requires Pure Resource clusters and multiblock; cannot promise two ingots per ordinary raw ore.

records.benefit: Potential portable storage item identified in Pastel's 1.21.1 advancement/progression list.
records.caveat: Investigate actual capacity, acquisition tier, and bag-nesting policy first.

records.benefit: Raw Soulstone smelts into two Processed Soulstone; easy early access to Malum's guide and first tools.
records.caveat: The 2:1 here is a MOD RESOURCE recipe, not general ore doubling.

records.benefit: Produces valuable reagents, including redstone/glowstone, and processes metals into extra-output nodes.
records.caveat: Needs altar, spirits, rocks and repairable impetus; not a first-day magic doubling route.

records.benefit: Burn saplings/foods to generate ash and collect fumes; useful concurrent cooking and witchcraft byproducts.
records.caveat: NOT general metal ore smelting (Witchery-derived ovens don't smelt ores); check exact fuel/cooking speed.

records.benefit: Simple protective equipment so harvesting Mandrake doesn't punish the player.
records.caveat: Only relevant once growing Mandrake.

records.benefit: Witchcraft-specific protection from selected threats and storage outside inventory.
records.caveat: Recipes and supported protections vary; do not treat all totems or death prevention as compatible until handler audit.

records.benefit: Harvest different barks from ordinary trees; unlocks first spell-crafting components.
records.caveat: Do not confuse with a generic tree-felling/wood-doubling axe.

records.benefit: Grind collected plants/bark into Growth, Spell and Mutating Powders.
records.caveat: Different from Mahou's item-powder doubling. Doesn't automatically yield 2 metal ingots.

records.benefit: An early soul collector fueled by killing mobs; entry into summon/utility focus crafts.
records.caveat: First Ectoplasm is a loot/mob constraint. No prebuilt generic summoned minions granted.

records.benefit: Stores several wand focuses to avoid carrying each one loose.
records.caveat: Useful once the player has a wand and focuses, not before.

records.benefit: Craft or loot an entry-level book to begin casting known scrolls.
records.caveat: Available spells are book/loot dependent; cannot promise a specific no-cost smelting/flying spell.

records.benefit: Provides spellbook upgrades and capacity beyond the very first cast.
records.caveat: Check actual requirements; crafted scroll forge requires crying obsidian.

records.benefit: Specialized resource and amethyst geode locating, potentially a strong anti-grind alternative.
records.caveat: ATM11 text is not guaranteed TMM recipe or early unlock. Check pinned Theurgy divination ritual and item ID.

records.benefit: Allows resource conversions after establishing its furnace heat, Sal Ammoniac and alchemical cycle.
records.caveat: Not equivalent to free early doubling; don't suggest post-gate resource conversion shortcuts.

records.benefit: Very early low-cost guide/prayer entry but not a proven general mining or smelting shortcut.
records.caveat: Worth only a guide link until a functional utility item is confirmed.

records.benefit: Large set of alchemical recipes, including mod-specific processing of mineral or gem dust.
records.caveat: Potential low-tier doubling is important but exact conversion costs/tier need installed recipe audit; do not claim ordinary 2x ores yet.

records.benefit: Programmable mining or block operations possible from a fairly early hardware tier.
records.caveat: Requires learning CAD spell programming and valid spell snippets, not a zero-effort vein miner.

records.benefit: Exploration reveals research progression; no specific universal early resource duplication confirmed.
records.caveat: Do not invent recipe or spell benefits; inspect the actual research tree.

records.benefit: Investigate early utility spells and media cost; no verified concrete universal shortcut yet.
records.caveat: Source on this entry is only an adjacent reference; replace with Hex Casting primary source before publication.

records.benefit: A Casting Lectern automatically casts a spell from a placed grimoire. It can be paired with targeting crystals and redirection for fixed base stations.
records.caveat: This is not Ars Nouveau's Storage Lectern. A smelting-specific spell on the lectern is NOT verified. Scriptor spell syntax differs per world; requires discovering or writing a suitable spell.

records.benefit: Check first instruments, relevant buffs, conversion rituals and whether they offer day-one labor savings.
records.caveat: Do not claim specific effects until checked in game.

records.benefit: Early Witchery oven processing can turn some ingredients or saplings into Wood Ash and capture useful fumes in jars, supporting basic witchcraft brewing.
records.caveat: Comparable ATM11-based reference, not TMM-recipe verified. Witch's Oven is not a generic high-speed ore smelter. Do not confuse with Enchanted: Witchcraft's independent oven.

records.benefit: Potential magical industrial ore-processing path, likely beyond first-day access.
records.caveat: Needs exact version-specific processing ratio and machinery validation.

records.unlock: Smelter Prism via Hephaestus Forge tier 1
records.benefit: When applied to a tool, can smelt drops from broken ore or blocks directly: raw ore→ingots, sand→glass, logs→charcoal.
records.caveat: Confirmed in a comparable ATM questbook, NOT proven in TMM. Tier 1 Forge needs a substantial 9x9 setup and essence/ritual inputs, and the prism needs Elementarium Relic. Not a day-one tool.

records.benefit: Mana-fed flower powers and speeds nearby ordinary furnaces, potentially eliminating separate coal and shortening bulk-smelting time.
records.caveat: Requires Endoflame/Mana Spreader/Pool and crafting an Exoflame; behavior is proven for original Botania, but verify 1.21.1 Revived port and exact flower recipe. Not truly day one.

records.benefit: Point at a lit normal Furnace and manually right-click to increase smelting speed and fuel efficiency. Also helps Mana Pool output throughput.
records.caveat: Manual operator required; not equivalent to an automatic ore doubler. Verify recipe and mechanism in the Revived port.

records.benefit: Right-click target smeltable placed blocks; for example sand to glass and cobblestone to stone/smooth stone.
records.caveat: Acts on placed block transformations only, not evidence of smelting inventory raw ores or dusts; mana/tool recipe and port support need testing.

records.benefit: Temporarily highlights nearby hidden ore blocks through terrain for a moderate Mana cost.
records.caveat: Not an ore generator or a general cross-dimensional scanner; verify port and requirements.

records.benefit: Stores large quantities of one kind of block in a dedicated carried item to reduce bulk-mining inventory management.
records.caveat: Mana progress and recipe required. Audit for portable-bag nesting compatibility; it is not a general backpack.
